name: Shelfwise
summary: A personal reading list where you save books by title and author, move them from Want to read to Reading to Finished, rate finished books, and see simple reading stats.
personas: Casual reader who wants one place to remember recommended books and what they thought of the ones they finished
Avid reader (20+ books a year) who tracks yearly progress, average rating and books per month, and needs search and sort

features.name: Add a book
features.description: Form at /books/new with Title (required, max 200), Author (required, max 120), Status (default 'Want to read'), Pages (optional positive whole number), Notes (optional, max 2000). A star Rating input appears only when Status is Finished. Inline errors 'Title is required', 'Author is required', 'Pages must be a positive whole number'. On save, redirect to / with toast 'Book added'.

features.name: Library with status tabs
features.description: Home page / lists book cards (generated initials cover, title, author, status, rating for finished books). Tabs 'All · N', 'Want to read · N', 'Reading · N', 'Finished · N' filter via ?status=want|reading|finished. Empty library shows 'Your shelf is empty' with 'Add your first book' link; empty tab shows 'No books in {Status}'.

features.name: Quick status changes
features.description: Status select (accessible name 'Status for {title}') on each card and the detail page. Moving to Reading sets the started date if unset; moving to Finished sets the finished date to today; moving to Want to read clears the started date. Toasts 'Moved to Want to read', 'Moved to Reading', 'Marked as finished'.

features.name: Rate finished books
features.description: Finished books show 'Rate this book' with star buttons 'Rate 1 star' to 'Rate 5 stars'. Rated books show stars with accessible name 'Rated N out of 5' and a 'Clear rating' button; unrated finished books show 'Not rated'. Non-finished books never show rating controls. Leaving Finished clears the rating and finished date.

features.name: Reading stats
features.description: /stats shows stat cards Total books, Want to read, Reading, Finished, Finished this year, Pages read, Average rating (one decimal, '—' if none rated); a 'Finished per month' bar chart for the last 12 months with bars named '{Mon YYYY}: N books'; a 'Rating distribution' list '5 stars' to '1 star' with counts. With no books shows 'No stats yet' and an 'Add a book' link.

features.name: Book detail and edit
features.description: /books/{id} shows the title as h1, author, status select, rating, pages, notes, 'Added on', 'Started on', 'Finished on' dates (en-US medium, e.g. 'Sep 30, 2026'). /books/{id}/edit is the prefilled F1 form; save shows toast 'Changes saved' and returns to the detail page. Unknown id shows 'Book not found' with 'Back to library' link.

features.name: Delete with confirmation and undo
features.description: 'Delete' on the detail page opens a dialog 'Delete "{title}"?' with 'Cancel' and 'Delete'. Confirming redirects to / with toast 'Book deleted' and an 'Undo' action that restores the book with its status, rating, dates and notes (soft delete).

features.name: Search and sort
features.description: 'Search books' input (placeholder 'Search title or author') filters by case-insensitive substring of title or author, synced to ?q=. 'Sort by' select: Recently added (default), Title (A–Z), Author (A–Z), Highest rated, synced to ?sort=recent|title|author|rating. Combines with status tab. No matches shows 'No books match "{q}"' with 'Clear search' button.

features.name: Demo data and settings
features.description: Database seeded on first run with 12 demo books (3 Want to read, 2 Reading, 7 Finished and rated). /settings has Theme (Light, Dark, System), 'Restore demo data' (confirm, then toast 'Demo data restored') and 'Delete all books' (dialog 'Delete all books?', then toast 'All books deleted').

features.name: Theme, responsive layout and system states
features.description: Header 'Toggle theme' button switches light/dark and persists across reloads. Layout works from 375px width without horizontal scroll with 'Library', 'Stats', 'Settings' nav links visible. Loading skeletons for library, detail and stats; error boundary 'Something went wrong' with 'Try again'.

features.name: Yearly reading goal
features.description: On /stats, 'Set goal' accepts a whole number 1–999; a 'Reading goal {year}' card shows '{finished this year} of {goal} books' and a progressbar with aria-valuenow = finished this year and aria-valuemax = goal. Editable.

features.name: Pick my next read
features.description: On the Want to read tab, 'Pick my next read' opens a dialog 'Your next read' showing a random Want to read book with 'Pick another' and 'Start reading'; 'Start reading' moves it to Reading. Hidden when there are no Want to read books.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: Status tabs, search, sort, book cards with inline status and rating, empty states, Pick my next read

screens.name: Add book
screens.purpose: Create a book with title, author, status, optional pages, notes and rating

screens.name: Book detail
screens.purpose: Full book info, status change, rating, dates, notes, edit and delete

screens.name: Stats
screens.purpose: Stat cards, finished-per-month chart, rating distribution, yearly goal

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Theme choice, restore demo data, delete all books

screens.name: Not found
screens.purpose: Shown for unknown paths and book ids, with a link back to the library

non_goals: User accounts, login, multi-user or sharing
Fetching metadata or covers from external book APIs
Page-by-page progress tracking, reading sessions or timers
Social feeds, recommendations or long-form reviews
Custom shelves or tags beyond the three statuses
Payments, notifications, native mobile apps, offline/PWA support
assumptions: Single-user local app with no authentication; data stored in SQLite on the server.
Statuses are exactly Want to read, Reading, Finished; no Abandoned/DNF status.
Ratings are whole stars 1–5, only for Finished books.
Leaving Finished clears rating and finished date; moving to Want to read clears the started date; moving to Reading keeps an existing started date.
A book can be created directly as Finished with an optional rating; its finished date is the creation date.
Pages and Notes are optional fields added beyond the prompt to enable 'Pages read' and personal notes.

Default sort is Recently added (newest first); Title and Author sorts are case-insensitive plain alphabetical without stripping articles; Highest rated puts rated books by rating desc, then unrated, ties by title.
Search is case-insensitive substring on title or author; no pagination.
Year and month stats use the calendar in the server's local time zone; dates are shown in en-US medium format, e.g. 'Sep 30, 2026'.
Average rating is the mean of rated finished books rounded to one decimal; '—' when none rated.
Delete is a soft delete so Undo restores the book exactly; Undo is available while the toast is visible (about 6 seconds).
The reading goal is a single number for the current calendar year stored in a settings record; no goal by default.

Demo data (12 books listed in SPEC.md) is seeded automatically on first run with dates relative to seeding time, including at least one book finished in the current month; 'Restore demo data' resets to the same set and is how e2e tests reach a known state.
Theme defaults to System and persists via next-themes in localStorage.
